also: according to the terms of the treaty

terms.gloss: a treaty, a league, a compact
terms.comment: A treaty is made by striking: foedus īcere or ferīre, from the sacrifice that sealed it (Lewis & Short s.v. īciō).

phrases.english: according to the terms of the treaty
to conclude a treaty with someone

phrases.latin: Ex foedere, patria nostra amīcīs sociīsque in discrīmine succurrit.
phrases.english: According to the terms of the treaty, our country goes to the aid of its friends and allies in a crisis.

sources: Lewis & Short: foedus · Lewis & Short: icio · Lewis & Short: ferio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 184–188, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
